validation_criteria.R11: Real JSON queue/worker with differing UTC/local dates, each midnight separately, reservation keys and delivered note membership.
validation_criteria.R12: Real JSON both producer/consumer directions and both same-version controls, exact delivered completion percentage and repaired producer contract.
validation_criteria.R13: Real scheduled payload/score and persisted schedule time, replacement and ownership controls; processing a due job or test :at assertion is insufficient.
validation_criteria.R14: Real worker persistent 503: six requests across three attempts then recorded failure, 503-to-200 and 401 controls; test-adapter test name is insufficient.
validation_criteria.R15: Render/submit unbound GET search/filter, input names, method and resulting note membership.
validation_criteria.R16: Route drawing plus owner requests to both /notes and /journal with identical authorized lists/helpers.
validation_criteria.R17: Raised request exception and missing-record policy, normal and CI eager-loading modes.
validation_criteria.R18: Boot; details/summary and attachment markup retained; scripts, handlers and javascript URLs excluded.
validation_criteria.R19: Fresh-process special-character environment credentials, actual Basic header, successful metadata and bounded failures; no credential disclosure.
validation_criteria.R20: Gate off/on, create/edit/reload unequal YAML preferences and export heading; byte sample or green suite insufficient.
validation_criteria.R21: Create, editable name/heading update, attempted slug change and persisted slug, gate off/on.
validation_criteria.R23: Real PostgreSQL date decoding off/on, asymmetric UTC date counts, populated and empty reports and ownership.
validation_criteria.R25: Matching ETag in both list orders, conflicting and nonconflicting date validators, expired 302 and foreign 404, explicit keep/adopt decision.
